THE VERY DEFINITION

Multi-Flex Tailgate, available on all eight trim levels and providing six different functions to help improve loading,
unloading and accessing the cargo bed.

CONFIDENCE IS KEY.
Silverado offers integrated towing technology that delivers confidence and makes hauling big loads easy.

hitch area lighting, electric parking brake hookup assist, an integrated trailer brake controller, trailer

monitoring.4 New features include available Jack-Knife Alert,5 Trailer Length Indicator,5 Trailer Angle Indicator
